select count(distinct q.question_id) from edu_qb_question q where q.del_flag = '0' and q.status = '0' and ( q.chapter_id in ( with recursive chapter_tree as ( select chapter_id from edu_qb_chapter where chapter_id = #{chapterId} union all select c.chapter_id from edu_qb_chapter c inner join chapter_tree t on c.parent_id = t.chapter_id ) select chapter_id from chapter_tree ) or exists ( select 1 from ( with recursive chapter_tree as ( select chapter_id, chapter_name from edu_qb_chapter where chapter_id = #{chapterId} union all select c.chapter_id, c.chapter_name from edu_qb_chapter c inner join chapter_tree t on c.parent_id = t.chapter_id ) select chapter_name from chapter_tree ) ct where ( q.chapter_text = ct.chapter_name or q.chapter_text ilike (ct.chapter_name || ' > %') or q.chapter_text ilike ('% > ' || ct.chapter_name) or q.chapter_text ilike ('% > ' || ct.chapter_name || ' > %') ) ) )
